force 不接受旧缓存 flight；与实际 fetch 合并，并复用请求到达后已完成的真实发布，避免慢 waiter 再次查询。
新 Claude 能力及多来源价格对照；保留 Sol → Terra 前两位和原 Terra 价卡，不构建万能模型表。
本报告与 validation JSON 关联实际命令、日志摘要、源码 SHA 和限制；保护 baseline 未改。

initial_complete_gate_run.evidence_scope: Original full repository run at source_snapshot, with the separately documented image fixture cleanup. Frontend evidence for the final files is superseded by additional_review_round_2.frontend_gate.

initial_post_gate_test_fixture_edits.change: Remove the unused embedded recorder field from the test fixture; no production or test behavior changes.

additional_review_round_3.scope: Expand review across all 83 changed files and their protocol, retry, authentication, account-quota, pricing, payment and migration callers. Apply only reproduced local repairs; retain the frozen implementations and protected business contracts.

findings_fixed.finding: Growing the function-call slice copied non-empty strings.Builder values and could panic when interleaved argument deltas resumed.
findings_fixed.fix: Keep each buffered call at a stable pointer address.

findings_fixed.finding: A completed custom_tool_call carries full input in Input; the compatibility accumulator read only Arguments and lost or truncated it.
findings_fixed.fix: Use the terminal custom-tool input while retaining the established function_call compatibility representation, metadata and deduplication.

findings_fixed.finding: Invalid custom fallback model values could publish negative prices or silently remove a valid last-good model.
findings_fixed.fix: Validate consumed numeric fields, types and model object shape before publication; retain explicit zero and nullable fields, sample_spec and nested catalog metadata.

findings_fixed.finding: Startup fallback copied an invalid catalog over the last valid disk file before validation failed.
findings_fixed.fix: Validate and check custom-file fingerprint before copying; rejected fallback leaves the last-good disk catalog unchanged.

findings_fixed.finding: An older passive or active usage request could overwrite a successful same-account quota reset or saved auto-reset mode.
findings_fixed.fix: Successful mutations advance a data revision; older reads cannot publish stale data/errors, while their original loading lifetime still completes normally.

pricing_race_before_test_fixture_simplif.note: Later test-only simplification reads the bundled catalog directly; final full gates retest the final fixture.

intermediate_complete_run.note: Two frontend edits and one test-fixture simplification occurred during this intermediate run. It is not used as the final same-snapshot evidence; the separate final-gate run freezes all source.

limitations: Same release blockers remain; no protected baseline, deployment code, dependency or toolchain change.
Existing visual evidence remains the original 84 checks and 96 screenshots. Round-3 frontend edits affect result ownership only and do not change template or style.
No real provider, CLI, payment, production database, production p99, mixed-version replica or canary validation was performed.

additional_review_round_4.scope: Independently recheck reasoning-effort alias mapping, retry and billing boundaries, pricing fallback, and frontend async ownership after round 3. The earlier complete gate is historical evidence and is not represented as covering this round's source change.

findings_fixed.finding: When an OpenAI Messages request for a known GPT-6.1 Sol model was mapped to an opaque upstream model alias, Anthropic max was converted to xhigh before the group policy matched the original client model. A configured max-to-high mapping could be skipped; count_tokens had the same conversion boundary. Sol accepts xhigh, so this was a policy-mapping mismatch, not an xhigh validation rejection.
findings_fixed.fix: Before applying a bound Messages policy, restore the request's explicit output_config.effort (or effective none for disabled thinking) on the policy candidate. Apply model-scoped mappings and ceilings against the original client model, then validate and forward the resulting effort. Requests without an explicit effort retain converter defaults.
findings_fixed.protected_behavior: No cache, sticky, isolation, routing, billing usage, session, or frozen Edge behavior changed.
